title: ci: add artifact signing, SBOM provenance and release-manifests for private-installer builds
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: private deployments require verifiable artifacts (signed binaries, SBOMs/provenance, and a single release-manifests artifact) for air-gapped and audited installs. This PR wires signing and provenance into the CI pipeline for the private-installer build and publishes a release-manifests.json that contains metadata, SBOM links, and cosign signatures so downstream operators can verify integrity before installing.

What this PR does (high level): - Generate SBOMs for installer images and tarballs using Syft during the build. - Produce a provenance/release-manifests.json that aggregates artifact metadata, SBOM URIs, checksums, and cosign signatures. - Sign build artifacts (images and tarballs) with cosign in the CI (key material stored in Vault/KMS). - Add verification scripts (scripts/verify-release.sh) and a README section for operators that explains how to verify signatures and SBOMs offline. - Backfill signatures for the last two private-installer releases (scripts/backfill-signatures.sh) to ease migration for customers.

Checklist: [x] generate SBOMs (syft) [x] sign artifacts (cosign) [x] publish release-manifests.json [x] verification scripts & docs [x] CI e2e smoke tests for signed artifacts [x] update helm Chart metadata with provenance links

Related: Linear ENG-4821 (release provenance RFC), ENG-4890 (private-installer compliance), SUP-1289 (customer request for signed artifacts). Internal RFC: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/release-provenance-for-private-installer.

Notes on security: cosign key material is fetched from HashiCorp Vault in the CI using a constrained service role; signatures are not persisted in the primary build container filesystem (they are uploaded directly to the release bucket). The README includes rotation guidance and a short audit checklist.

Deployment/usage: release-manifests.json is uploaded alongside existing release artifacts under s3://redwood-private-installer/releases/<tag>/. operators should download the manifest and run scripts/verify-release.sh which validates checksums, SBOM presence, and cosign signatures using the public key provided in the manifest or via the organization's configured keyset.

release_notes:
- Add cosign signing of private-installer release artifacts (images and tarballs).
- Publish SBOMs (syft) for each artifact and include SBOM URIs in release-manifests.json.
- Introduce release-manifests.json (schema v1) that aggregates checksums, SBOMs, and signatures for operator verification.
- Provide scripts/verify-release.sh and operator docs on verification and key rotation.
- Backfill signatures for two prior releases to aid customer migration.
tests: unit: ci scripts unit tests - pass
integration: verify-release against staging bucket - pass
e2e: release-verification smoke - pass in CI
notes: Operators should download release-manifests.json and run scripts/verify-release.sh before installing in air-gapped environments.
The cosign public key used for verification is published in the manifest; orgs with their own keys may override by passing --key to verify-release.sh.
Follow-up work: automate archive of signatures to long-term storage and add SLSA attestation in next milestone (ENG-5102).
